metadata.title: Vegetable Stew | Paite recipe
metadata.description:
This simple Manipuri vegetarian soup dish is made of select vegetables by boiling them with very few ingredients or spices. The lack of spices paves way for abundant amount of natural vegetable flavours  of the dish.
It is a wholesome vegetable stew, with strong note of ginger that lends in some heat. It is perfect for a cold winter evenings.
